_: THE CASCADE'S HARD RULES, per job class (LACUNA-1.3-DESIGN §40.3: W1's machine check is the 26B plus hard rules). A rung's answer that breaks one climbs, whatever its certainty; at the last rung it is refused. `answer`: the kind of form the job must answer with. Each rule: `field` of the slice the mind was shown, `match` (every pattern must match; JavaScript regex source, `flags` optional), and `never` (labels it may not be).
